title: Closed-form estimation and uniform inference in additively separable triangular models with a nonseparable first stage
abstract: arXiv:2608.22605v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper studies the nonparametric identification and estimation of additively separable triangular models with continuous endogenous and instrumental variables, allowing for a nonseparable first-stage equation. Under the independence of instrumental variables and unobservables, we show that the outcome function possesses a closed-form expression as a functional of conditional cumulative distribution functions. The resulting plug-in estimators require no regularization and converge at the rate $n^{-m/(2m+1)}$, where $m$ is the order of smoothness the model imposes. Also, no estimator of the outcome function converges faster. We use the empirical bootstrap to construct a uniform confidence band that covers the outcome function at every point of a compact set simultaneously.

translated_title: 可加可分离三角模型中闭式估计与一致推断，允许第一阶段不可分离
translated_abstract: 本文研究了具有连续内生变量和工具变量的可加可分离三角模型的非参数识别与估计，允许第一阶段方程不可分离。在工具变量与不可观测项独立的假设下，我们证明结果函数具有闭式表达式，作为条件累积分布函数的泛函。所得的插入式估计量无需正则化，并以速率$n^{-m/(2m+1)}$收敛，其中$m$为模型施加的光滑性阶数。此外，没有结果函数的估计量能收敛得更快。我们使用经验自助法构建一致置信带，该置信带在紧集上的每一点同时覆盖结果函数。
tldr: 本文提出一种无需正则化的闭式估计方法，用于可加可分离三角模型，允许第一阶段不可分离，并实现最优收敛速率及一致置信带。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a regularization-free closed-form estimation method for additively separable triangular models with a nonseparable first stage, achieving optimal convergence rates and uniform confidence bands.
